headline: Lucy Beaumont 歌單告白
context: 英國喜劇演員 Lucy Beaumont 分享私人歌單：四、五歲愛上同樣來自赫爾的 The Housemartins，第一張買的單曲是麥可傑克森的 Thriller。至於 Coldplay，她說主唱人看起來很好——但音樂讓她想暈車。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: As a tween, Hull’s finest learned the rap from Waterfalls – now she blubs to prog. But which song from a British singer-songwriter is her guilty pleasure? The first song I fell in love with Caravan of Love by the Housemartins, when I was four or five. They’re also from Hull, but I think I mainly liked it because my granny and grandad had a caravan in their garden that I used as a wendy house. The first single I bought I remember buying Thriller by Michael Jackson from HMV in Hull, even though it was before my time. Everyone loved Michael Jackson so I was probably copying somebody at school. Continue reading...
sources.title: ‘Chris Martin seems nice – but Coldplay make me feel carsick!’: Lucy Beaumont’s honest playlist

claim_trace.claim: Lucy Beaumont 在訪談中分享歌單，包括 Housemartins、Thriller 與對 Coldplay 的評語。
claim_trace.source_title: ‘Chris Martin seems nice – but Coldplay make me feel carsick!’: Lucy Beaumont’s honest playlist

thread_text:
英國喜劇演員 Lucy Beaumont 攤開自己的歌單：第一首愛上的歌是四、五歲時聽的 Caravan of Love，唱的 The Housemartins 跟她一樣來自赫爾（Hull）；第一張買的單曲是麥可傑克森的 Thriller。至於 Coldplay——她說主唱 Chris Martin 人看起來很好，但他們的音樂讓她想暈車。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 9 日發佈的訪談。
threads_text:
英國喜劇演員 Lucy Beaumont 把自己的歌單攤開來聊。第一首愛上的歌，是四、五歲時聽的 Caravan of Love——唱的 The Housemartins 跟她一樣來自赫爾（Hull），她說喜歡的原因大概是爺爺奶奶花園裡那台被她當祕密基地的露營車。第一張買的單曲是麥可傑克森的 Thriller。至於 Coldplay，她的評語是：主唱 Chris Martin 人看起來很好——但他們的音樂讓她想暈車。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 8 月 9 日發佈的訪談，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
